title: Verify Grok CLI headless contract and register it as a dev-loop driver
body:
Verify the Grok CLI against the dev-loop vendor contract and, if it conforms,
register it in `loop.sh`'s dev-agent registry (the `DEV_AGENT_IDS` list and its
detect/invocation entries, ~3 lines) so `AI_AGENT=grok ./loop.sh` works like
codex/claude/gemini.

The contract (loop.sh vendor section): read the cycle prompt from STDIN, edit
files in `$PWD`, run non-interactively, exit nonzero on failure. To verify:
run the CLI headless with a trivial prompt in a scratch directory and confirm
all four properties, then record the exact flags used in the registry entry.

Context: a `grok.exe` process was observed running on the dev machine
(2026-08-30, the #306 playtest wave driver spawns `grok` directly), but the
CLI did not resolve on the verifying session's PATH, so the flags could not be
verified then — do not add the registry entry on faith. Until this lands, a
Grok dev lane runs via `AI_AGENT_CMD="grok <verified-flags>" ./loop.sh`
(documented in docs/parallel_lanes.md).

While in there, note the codex-only `AI_CODEX_SANDBOX` knob: decide whether an
equivalent is needed per vendor or whether the generic contract suffices.
